status.en: 16 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 129% more than the week before, most of them in Mogadishu, Puntland and Baidoa.
status.nb: 16 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 129 prosent flere enn uken før, flest i Mogadishu, Puntland og Baidoa.

summary.en: Fitgharan forces continue to hold the Mogadishu-Baidoa corridor while Laftagareen forces have taken Buurhakaba and opposition fighters have seized a third town in a week, intensifying fighting in the Bay region. Ethiopia is reported to be supporting al-Shabaab militants in the Southwest State and is planning a troop withdrawal from Somalia as fighting intensifies at home. Somalia is screening travelers after Kenya confirmed an imported Ebola case and is deepening defence ties with Pakistan by agreeing to acquire JF‑17 fighter jets. The ICRC says 148 wounded were treated after heavy fighting in Baidoa town, and there were 2,284 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

background.title: Somali Civil War (2009–present)
background.extract: The ongoing phase of the Somali Civil War began in 2009 and is concentrated in southern and central Somalia, primarily between the forces of the Federal Government of Somalia (FGS), assisted by African Union peacekeeping forces, and the Islamist militant group al-Shabaab, which pledged allegiance to al-Qaeda in 2012.
